title: unified-rollouts-enhance-auto-rollback-canary-shadow-workflow
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Enhances auto-rollback workflow for unified rollouts: improved multi-metric decisioning, staged shadow probing, quarantine for flapping rollouts, and observability additions (metrics/logs/dashboards). Includes e2e tests and docs.
description: This change augments the unified rollouts auto-rollback engine to make canary/A-B/shadow workflows safer and more robust in production. Motivation: customers running large-scale canaries and shadow experiments reported flappy rollouts and insufficient signal isolation when multiple signals (latency, p99 errors, model-quality regressions) move together. This PR implements: 1) multi-metric quorum decisioning: rollbacks now evaluate composite metrics with configurable weights and quorum thresholds so single noisy metrics do not trigger unnecessary rollbacks; 2) staged shadow probing: shadow traffic ramps are extended with active probing windows to surface regressions in low-traffic variants before they affect canaries; 3) quarantine for flapping rollouts: repeated rapid roll/unroll cycles move a variant into a temporary quarantine with exponential backoff and alerting; 4) enhanced rollback safety guards: minimum observation windows, cooldown periods, and rate-limited rollback actions to avoid thrashing; 5) observability: new metrics, tracing hooks, and a rollback dashboard in the Console for per-rollout timelines and decision traces; 6) compatibility: fallback to legacy single-metric behavior via rollout policy flag to preserve existing customers' behavior; 7) tests and docs: unit tests, e2e stability tests in perf-cluster, and updated docs with migration notes and recommended configs. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of multi-metric engine and decision API - [x] Staged shadow probing logic and config knobs - [x] Quarantine/backoff implementation and alerts - [x] Console dashboard and tracing support - [x] Unit + integration + e2e tests - [x] Docs and migration guide - [x] Feature gated and off by default for existing rollouts Backwards compatibility: rollout policies default to previous behavior unless "multi_metric_auto_rollback" is enabled. Linear/Jira: ENG-4821, ENG-4890, SUP-1128. See rollout design doc link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4821/unified-rollouts-auto-rollback-enhancements.
